_comment: Patterns consumed by secret-scan.ps1. Edit this file to add or remove patterns globally for the toolkit. For project-specific additions (e.g. an in-house bearer-token shape), drop a sibling file `patterns-local.json` with the same shape - it will be merged in and is typically gitignored.
_pattern_authoring_tips: Patterns are .NET regex strings. Use (?i) at the start for case-insensitive.
Test against synthetic strings before deploying - false positives block real edits.
Block patterns trigger exit 2 (hard refusal). Warn patterns log to stderr and allow.
